integrity: Proof is a complete combinatorial argument for every positive integer m. Independent standard-library enumeration checks m=1 through 8 but is not a replacement for the proof. No authorship or independent verification claim.
limitations: Synchronous deterministic open-neighborhood binary majority with retention at ties; friendship graphs formed by m>=1 triangles sharing a hub. No result for other graph families, tie randomization, or asynchronous dynamics; originality may overlap unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Exact attraction basins and rapid stabilization of majority dynamics on friendship graphs
